title: P3: MomentumRotationStrategy — 动量轮动策略实现
description: 实现动量轮动策略，横截面动量排名Top-N品种选择。需多品种数据管理和横截面排名逻辑

criteria: grep -r 'class MomentumRotationStrategy' quantflow/strategy/templates/ — 找到类定义

key_methods.generate_signals: def generate_signals(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.Series, pd.Series]
key_methods.generate_cross_sectional_signals: def generate_cross_sectional_signals(self, data_dict: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, tuple[pd.Series, pd.Series]]
key_methods.on_bar: def on_bar(self, ctx: StrategyContext, bar: Bar) -> None

generate_signals_logic: 1. 计算单品种动量得分：momentum_score = close.pct_change(self._lookback_period)
2. 计算相对强度：rs = momentum_score.rolling(self._lookback_period).mean() — 简化版单品种
3. 单品种入场：momentum_score > 0 且 close > close.rolling(self._lookback_period).mean()
4. 单品种出场：momentum_score < 0 或 stop_loss触发
5. 返回单品种的entries/exits（用于回测兼容）
generate_cross_sectional_signals_logic: 3. 在每个时间点，对所有symbol的momentum_score排名
6. 跌出Top-N或止损则生成exit信号
details.on_bar_logic: 维护self._symbol_bars: dict[str, list[Bar]]，按symbol分组累积Bar。每个rebalance_period重新计算排名
details.special_note: generate_signals保持StrategyBase签名（单品种兼容），新增generate_cross_sectional_signals处理多品种轮动逻辑

details.content:
strategy:
  name: "momentum_rotation"
  symbol: "BTC/USDT"
  timeframe: "1d"
  params:
    lookback_period: 20
    top_n: 3
    rebalance_period: 5
    momentum_method: "rate_of_change"
    stop_loss_pct: -0.05
    atr_period: 14
    volume_period: 20
    symbols:
      - "BTC/USDT"
      - "ETH/USDT"
      - "SOL/USDT"
      - "DOGE/USDT"
      - "XRP/USDT"
  exit:
    stop_loss_pct: -0.05
    take_profit_pct: 0.15
    trailing_stop_pct: 0.03

details.helper: _make_multi_symbol_ohlcv(symbols=['BTC/USDT','ETH/USDT','SOL/USDT'], n=200, seed=42) — 生成多品种数据dict
test_methods: test_generate_signals — 单品种模式，用_make_ohlcv(200)，断言entries/exits长度==df长度
test_generate_cross_sectional_signals — 用_make_multi_symbol_ohlcv，断言返回dict包含所有symbol，每个(entries,exits)长度匹配
test_top_n_selection — 构造3品种数据其中1品种动量最强，断言该品种在cross_sectional结果中有entry信号

files.description: MomentumRotationStrategy策略实现，横截面动量排名+Top-N轮动

risks: 多品种数据对齐：不同品种K线数量可能不一致，需按timestamp inner join
回测引擎当前仅支持单品种，P3的cross_sectional模式需特殊处理
